heroHeadline: Pennsylvania reports 5th measles-associated death as outbreak reaches new mortality milestone
heroSubtitle: Pennsylvania's 5th measles-associated death (Oct 1, 2026) deepens the toll of the ongoing northeastern outbreak. The state's broad 'measles-associated' classification (any positive test, regardless of immediate cause) puts its count at 5, while coroner cause-of-death determinations stand at 4 and CDC's federal tally remains at 3. Pennsylvania had already overtaken South Carolina as the year's largest single-state outbreak, with over 676 cases across 37 counties. PAHO's US elimination status decision remains due November 2026.
